G1 E5 F200 ; extrude 5mm of filament to help prime the nozzle just prior to the start of the print

M73 P0; enable build progress
M104 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} T0; set nozzle temperature
M126 S0; Turn off fan
G21; set units to mm
G90; set positioning to absolute
G130 X80 Y80 A127 B127 ; Set Stepper Vref to default value

; Home xy-axis
G162 X Y F2500; home XY axes maximum
G92 X0 Y0
G1 X-5 Y-5 F2500
G162 X Y F200; home XY axes maximum slowly
G92 X132.5 Y120

; Home z-axis
G161 Z F1100; home Z axis minimum
G92 Z0
G1 Z2 F1100
G161 Z F100; home Z axis minimum slowly
G92 Z0
M132 Z; Recall home offsets for Z

; Calibrate point 1 (we're already at point 1)
M131 A; store surface calibration point 1
G1 Z2 F1100; back up from buildplate

; Calibrate point 2
G1 X-44.5 Y120 F7000; move to 2nd probing point
G161 Z F100
M131 B; store surface calibration point 1
G1 Z2 F1100; back up from buildplate

; Calibrate point 3
G1 X132.5 Y-110 F7000; move to 2nd probing point
G161 Z F100
M131 AB; store surface calibration point 3
G1 Z2 F1100; back up from buildplate
M132 AB; Activate auto-leveling
G1 Z1 F1000

; Lay prime strip
M133 T0; stabilize extruder temperature
M126 S{cool_fan_speed_0}; Activate fan
G4 P1000; Wait a little bit longer
G1 X80 Y-110 Z0.2 F1000

G1 X-20 E12.5 F1000
G92 E0 ; Set E to 0
